title: PnP Community Pets — Mascot Manifest
description: Drop this file in your mascot folder under media/pets/<your-mascot>/mascot.json

id.description: Unique ID for this mascot. Defaults to the folder name if omitted.

name.description: Display name shown in the mascot picker.

description.description: One-line description shown in the mascot picker.

type.description: Sprite format. Choose the one that matches your asset files.

frameWidth.description: Width the mascot is drawn at on the canvas, in pixels. Default: 128.

frameHeight.description: Height the mascot is drawn at on the canvas, in pixels. Default: 128.

idle.description: GIF/PNG-sheet: filename of the idle asset. SVG-frames: filename or array of filenames.

walkRight.description: GIF/PNG-sheet: filename of the walk-right asset. SVG-frames: filename or array of filenames.

walkLeft.description: Optional. If omitted the renderer mirrors walkRight automatically.

src.description: PNG-sheet only: filename of the sprite sheet PNG.

framesPerRow.description: PNG-sheet only: number of animation frames per row. Default: 4.

rows.description: PNG-sheet only: row index for each animation state. Defaults to idle=0, walkRight=1, walkLeft=2.

tintable.description: If true, pixels matching chromaColor are replaced with the user's chosen tint color at draw time.

chromaColor.description: The chroma-key color painted on tintable areas (default: #FF00FF). Use a color that never appears naturally in the art.

unlockedByBadgeId.description: Optional Credly badge ID. When set, this mascot only appears in the picker after the user earns that badge.
